headline: Pinnacle Logistics reports record quarterly revenue
body: Pinnacle Logistics reported revenue growth of 11% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Pinnacle Logistics wins quality award from industry association
body: Pinnacle Logistics received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Pinnacle Logistics announces layoffs affecting 16% of workforce
body: Pinnacle Logistics said it will cut 16% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Data breach at Pinnacle Logistics exposes customer records
body: Pinnacle Logistics disclosed unauthorized access to systems holding customer records. Regulators have been notified and affected customers are being contacted.

headline: Pinnacle Logistics signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Pinnacle Logistics announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.
